design.concept: A ledger bench for the collaborator's own expenses: the table of expenses leads on the left and never leaves the screen, while a working panel on the right changes between three views: consult the selected expense (data and available actions), register a new expense, and correct a rejected expense. Selecting a row, registering and correcting all happen without losing the list or the selection.

views.purpose: Default view of the panel: detail of the selected expense and the send/resend actions that fit its situation.
Form to register a new expense (date, category, amount, description), opened from the header button; returns to the detail of the newly registered expense on success.
Form prefilled with the rejected expense data to correct it; returns to the detail on success, where resubmission is offered.

design.decisions: Followed the ledgerTable template: dense table first, amount last and right-aligned in tabular figures with BRL, status as a text chip, failure shown above the rows with retry, loading skeleton in the table. A collaborator filter field above the table now calls filterListaMinhasDespesas with the typed value (empty clears the filter), so the journey steps that locate expenses are wired. Load-more paging is exposed. The scene host covers only the right panel, so the table stays visible and the selection survives view changes. Actions appear according to status and 'reenvioRealizado'; drafts are prefilled from the selected row before correcting, sending or resending.
